description: 黑车牺牲引离白车，消除对白后的保护
explanation_en: A simple example of removing the defender: deflect the rook that protects the white queen, then capture the queen.

intro.popup: 💡 消除保护：白车Rd1正在保护Qd4。黑方如何消除这个保护，吃掉白后？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Remove the defender: White's rook on d1 protects the queen on d4. How can Black remove the defender and win the queen?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Re1+将白车引离d1，Qd4失去唯一保护者，Qxd4+轻松得后！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Re1+ deflects the rook from d1, leaving the queen on d4 without its only defender. Black then wins it with Qxd4+.

moves.popup: 车牺牲！Re1+强制白车离开d1，消除对Qd4的保护。
moves.popup_en: Black sacrifices the rook with Re1+, forcing White's rook away from d1 and removing the queen's defender.

moves.popup: 白车被迫吃车，d4失去保护者！
moves.popup_en: White's rook is forced to capture. The queen on d4 has lost its defender.

moves.popup: 吃掉无保护的白后！消除保护战术成功。
moves.popup_en: Black captures the undefended queen. The removal-of-the-defender tactic succeeds.
